description: Update a world-graph entity: notes, description, status (TRACKED / ARCHIVED) and pin. Manage alias spellings with add_aliases / remove_aliases - aliases teach session processing which names map to this entity.

remove_aliases.description: Existing alias strings to remove (case-insensitive match)
